metadata.description: Personal Agent Skills by vdsmon, packaged as a plugin marketplace. Each skill ships as its own plugin so you can pick and choose. Plugins prefixed with cc- are Claude-Code-specific (hooks, dynamic context injection, or ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}), and unprefixed plugins port cleanly to other SKILL.md-native hosts (OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Goose, Copilot, etc.).

plugins.name: slack-draft
plugins.description: Draft a Slack message for the user to send: Slack mrkdwn, lead-with-conclusion, backticked identifiers and domain values, ASCII punctuation. Defaults to English and a plain high-level register, or pass --tech for a code-reading peer. Draft only, never posts. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: skill-polish
plugins.description: Post-mortem for any skill: finds friction in a session, traces it to the responsible skill file, and edits that file's source checkout, not the plugin install copy. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: cc-cache-keepalive
plugins.description: Keeps Claude Code's prompt cache warm on Max plans with a silent cron you arm per session. It cancels any tick that a recent real turn or an already-expired cache makes pointless. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: cc-usage-guard
plugins.description: Pauses Claude Code before it hits the 5-hour or weekly usage limit and auto-resumes when the window resets, on every surface including the desktop app. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: prep-compact
plugins.description: Audit in-flight session state before compaction truncates history, and save what would be lost. Commits real work locally, syncs stale plan and state files, and notes chat-only decisions, asking first only for risky items, then prints a paste-ready /compact message plus a queued follow-up. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: prep-exit
plugins.description: Save what only the conversation knows before a session ends, so a fresh session can pick up the work. Commits real work locally, syncs state files, writes a handoff note and a memory pointer, asks once only for risky items, and prints a paste-ready resume prompt. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: prep-goal
plugins.description: Interrogate a rough objective into a tight, verifiable /goal completion condition before handing it to an autonomous goal loop. Pins the end-state, a gate whose raw output the loop pastes, a scope fence, the forbidden cheat, and a turn cap. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: Strip AI-writing tells from text. Detects em-dash overuse, AI vocabulary, inflated significance, rule-of-three, sycophancy, compound coinages, and 20+ more patterns. `--casual` also adds the small inconsistencies real writers have. Outputs only the corrected text and edits files in place. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: brainstorming
plugins.description: Design-before-code gate that sizes each request as a spike, a bounded change, or architectural work, and gets approval on a design before any code. Only architectural work gets a written spec and a planning handoff. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: systematic-debugging
plugins.description: Four-phase debugging discipline (root-cause investigation, pattern analysis, hypothesis, single-fix implementation). No fixes before investigation; 3+ failed fixes means stop and question the architecture. For bugs in code you can run. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: skill-smith
plugins.description: Build and test Agent Skills with a baseline-first eval loop (Sonnet runs, benchmark viewer) and a skill-design vocabulary. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Removes local git branches and worktrees that are safely merged into dev/develop/master/main, skipping dirty worktrees and the main checkout. Squash-merge aware on GitHub remotes. Also clears clean detached worktrees whose commits are on a branch, and prunes worktrees whose folder is gone. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: strip-migration-cruft
plugins.description: Finds comments and docs that narrate past project history (phase, wave, story, migration notes), sorts cruft from live meaning, and strips the cruft after confirmation. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Relentless interview that stress-tests a plan, decision, or idea one round of questions at a time, until you and the agent agree. Bundles grilling, grill-with-docs (grill and write docs as you go), and domain-modeling (sharpen project terms in GLOSSARY.md). Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: Stateful, multi-session teaching workspace that turns a topic into short HTML lessons built for long-term retention. Grounds each lesson in a MISSION.md and trusted RESOURCES.md, and tracks progress in learning records and a GLOSSARY.md. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules: a lot of behaviour behind a small interface, placed at a clean seam, testable through that interface. Adds the deletion test, the one-adapter-vs-two seam rule, a deepening guide, and design-it-twice. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: question
plugins.description: Answer a genuine question in full, with no edits and no side effects. Treats 'why X and not Y?' as curiosity, not as a hidden request to switch to Y or an attack on X. Investigates read-only, explains the tradeoff, gives an honest verdict, and stops. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: open-pr
plugins.description: Write a short, plain pull request description a teammate reads in a minute: what changes, why now, what they must do. A script checks length, file-list bullets, AI tells, local paths and attribution. The user approves the text before any push or PR. Use for 'open a PR' or 'update the PR body'. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: start-work
plugins.description: Start each job in its own git worktree, based on a fresh fetch of the remote, without switching the main checkout. Copies ignored files listed in .worktreeinclude, keeps the worktree folder out of git status, enters it, and runs the repo's setup. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.
